en_title: Over Half of GTA 6 Watch Time Came From Viewers Under 25 Years Old
cn_title: 《GTA 6》超过一半的观看时长来自25岁以下观众
opus_summary: StreamsCharts数据显示，《GTA 6》直播观众多数年龄在25岁以下，其中20至24岁观众占30.8%。美国观众占比最高，巴西以12.4%紧随其后。游戏发售后，《GTA 5》等内容在Twitch上的观看量有所下降。

paragraphs.en: The bulk of fans watching streams of GTA 6 are under 25 years old, according to recent stats compiled by StreamsCharts.
paragraphs.cn: 根据StreamsCharts最近汇总的统计数据，观看《GTA 6》直播的大多数粉丝年龄在25岁以下。

paragraphs.en: After 13 long years, GTA 6 is finally out in the wild. Rockstar’s highly anticipated release has already broken numerous records, one of the most impressive being that it became the single most popular game ever on both Twitch and Kick just 26 hours after its global release.
paragraphs.cn: 经过漫长的13年，《GTA 6》终于正式推出。Rockstar这款备受期待的作品已经打破了多项纪录，其中最令人印象深刻的一项是，它在全球发售仅26小时后，就成为Twitch和Kick两大平台有史以来最受欢迎的游戏。

paragraphs.en: Now that it’s had a little time to breathe, more data is rolling in, including information about who’s watching streamers play the game. StreamsCharts , a data analytics company that studies games-focused streaming platforms, discovered that most viewers of GTA 6 broadcasts tend to trend under the age of 25.
paragraphs.cn: 如今游戏推出已有一段时间，更多数据陆续出炉，其中包括哪些人在观看主播游玩这款游戏。研究游戏类直播平台的数据分析公司StreamsCharts发现，《GTA 6》直播的大多数观众年龄倾向于在25岁以下。

paragraphs.en: According to Streamlabs’ stats, 30.8% of viewers in GTA 6 streams are 20 - 24 years old, making up the bulk of those watching the game across Kick, Twitch, and YouTube. (Painfully, StreamsCharts pointed out that these players were in elementary school when GTA 5 came out.) 16.8% of these viewers are 17 - 19, with 8.5% accounting for viewers 16 or under. The second-largest age range watching GTA 6 streams are viewers aged 25–29. 11.6% of viewers are 30–34, and the numbers keep dropping from there.
paragraphs.cn: 根据Streamlabs的统计数据，《GTA 6》直播观众中有30.8%年龄在20至24岁之间，是Kick、Twitch和YouTube上观看该游戏的最大群体。（令人感慨的是，StreamsCharts指出，《GTA 5》推出时，这些玩家还在上小学。）这些观众中有16.8%年龄在17至19岁之间，16岁及以下的观众占8.5%。观看《GTA 6》直播的第二大年龄群体是25至29岁的观众。30至34岁的观众占11.6%，更高年龄段的比例则持续下降。

paragraphs.en: StreamsCharts also found that an overwhelming majority of these viewers are single men, accounting for 83.8% of the gender divide. That’s not to say that gals aren’t also watching streamers play Rockstar’s latest; 14% of viewers are female, and if you’ve been on social media lately, you’ve probably seen a fair few female players showing off their outfits for Jason and Lucia or the viral conversation about how it’s, oddly, comparable to a crime-focused version of The Sims.
paragraphs.cn: StreamsCharts还发现，这些观众绝大多数是单身男性，在性别比例中占83.8%。这并不是说没有女性观看主播游玩Rockstar的最新作品；14%的观众是女性。如果你最近上过社交媒体，可能见过不少女性玩家展示她们为Jason和Lucia搭配的服装，或看到过一场广为传播的讨论：这款游戏竟然可以与以犯罪为主题的《模拟人生》相比较。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps unsurprisingly, the United States makes up the bulk of GTA 6 viewership. Brazil isn’t far behind, coming in at 12.4% of the game’s total audience; Spain and Germany follow at 6.9% and 6.8%, respectively.
paragraphs.cn: 或许并不令人意外，美国观众占《GTA 6》观众的大多数。巴西紧随其后，占游戏总观众的12.4%；西班牙和德国排在之后，分别占6.9%和6.8%。

paragraphs.en: Certain games have also experienced a drop in viewership following GTA 6’s release. StreamsCharts found that GTA 5 had the sharpest drop-off on Twitch, followed by the platform’s Just Chatting category and World of Warcraft.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》推出后，某些游戏的观看人数也出现了下降。StreamsCharts发现，《GTA 5》在Twitch上的观看人数降幅最大，其次是该平台的Just Chatting分类和《魔兽世界》。

paragraphs.en: The GTA hype train is in full swing, and it’s making big bucks for Rockstar. The company reportedly made a staggering $3.79 billion from the game in just 24 hours, making it the single biggest entertainment launch in history. Internet provider Comcast even revealed that it experienced its highest-traffic day ever as players downloaded the game to their consoles, and PlayStation confirmed that GTA 6 was its biggest game launch in the company’s history.
paragraphs.cn: 《侠盗猎车手》的热潮正如火如荼，也在为Rockstar赚取大笔收入。据报道，该公司仅用24小时就从这款游戏中获得了惊人的37.9亿美元收入，使其成为史上规模最大的娱乐作品发布。互联网服务提供商Comcast甚至透露，随着玩家将游戏下载到主机上，该公司经历了有史以来流量最高的一天，而PlayStation也确认，《GTA 6》是该公司历史上规模最大的游戏发布。
